rows.en: －　Yoh is standing in front of￥　　the drink dispenser　－
＊Yoh＊＠１９８＿００１Oh, hey, good work today!＝＠１９８＿００２Did you come to get something￥to drink too?
＊Yoh＊＠１９８＿００３Did you know if you press two￥buttons on this dispenser at￥once, you can mix the drinks?
＊Yoh＊＠１９８＿００４What I'm drinking right now is￥sports drink mixed with soda,￥and it's pretty good.
＊Yoh＊＠１９８＿００５So for you, as a special treat,￥I'll mix you some cola and￥orange soda!
＊Yoh＊＠１９８＿００６All right!￥No matter how it tastes, you￥have to drink it all!
＊Yoh＊＠１９８＿００７Aww, really?￥It might taste great, though...￥Let's try it!
＊Yoh＊＠１９８＿００８Hmm, this might be turning￥into a disaster...
＊Kaname＊＠１９８＿０１１Listen, this is bad!＝＠１９８＿０１２Just now on the news, they were￥talking about our candidate￥selection exam!
＊Kaname＊＠１９８＿０１３We're supposed to be kept secret￥from the press, right?＝＠１９８＿０１４Isn't this bad...?＝＠１９８＿０１５And Yoh, your parents were on￥there, talking about you.
＊Yoh＊＠１９８＿０１６What?＝＠１９８＿０１７What were they like?!￥What did they say?!
＊Kaname＊＠１９８＿０１９They're your parents, right...?￥I thought they seemed like￥decent people...
＊Kaname＊＠１９８＿０２１Yoh... what's wrong with you?￥You're kind of scaring me.
＊Yoh＊＠１９８＿０２２Just tell me! What did they say?
＊Kaname＊＠１９８＿０２３Huh? Um... about you, they said￥"We always knew he'd be chosen,"￥and "Of course, he's our child."
＊Sakaki＊＠１９８＿０２６Oh, you three. Did any of you￥happen to see the news￥broadcast?
＊Kaname＊＠１９８＿０２７Oh, I saw it.￥Um... Isn't everything about us￥supposed to be classified?
＊Sakaki＊＠１９８＿０２８Yes, it is. Most likely it￥leaked from someone connected to￥the project.＝＠１９８＿０２９We'll handle this news report￥properly, so don't worry.
＊Sakaki＊＠１９８＿０３０I know it's hard in a situation￥like this, but please stay￥focused on your training.
＊Kaname＊...＝＠１９９＿００１Well, I'm... going to head back.￥See you, Cousin.
＊Kaname＊...＝＠１９９＿００１Well, I'm... going to head back.￥See you, Cousin.
＊Yoh＊＠１９９＿００３What are they playing at?!￥Butting in now, after all￥this time...
＊Yoh＊＠１９９＿００４It had to be them!￥Why? Why butt in now, after￥all this time...
＊Yoh＊＠１９９＿００６No, knowing them, they must have￥come forward on their own...
＊Yoh＊＠１９９＿００９Thinking the secret might have￥leaked through people connected￥to me...＝＠１９９＿０１０doesn't feel great...
＊Yoh＊＠１９９＿０１１I see... So word about me got￥back to them too.＝＠１９９＿０１２I didn't think they knew...
＊Yoh＊＠１９９＿０１７Looks like I showed you￥a weird side of me...
